mcqs.question: By the end of 2027, how many greenfield Other Than Major Ports (OTMPs) does Andhra Pradesh plan to make operational?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh plans to make four greenfield Other Than Major Ports operational by the end of 2027. Three is the tempting alternative, but it does not match the stated target.

mcqs.question: With reference to Andhra Pradesh’s plan for its greenfield Other Than Major Ports, identify the incorrect statement.
options: The target is to increase OTMP cargo-handling capacity from 100 MTPA to 200 MTPA.
The planned increase would double the existing OTMP cargo-handling capacity.
The target cargo-handling capacity is 200 MTPA.
The target is to increase OTMP cargo-handling capacity from 100 MTPA to 300 MTPA.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes the target from 200 MTPA to 300 MTPA. Andhra Pradesh’s plan is to double OTMP cargo-handling capacity from 100 MTPA to 200 MTPA.
